title: Brand portal across devices

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Make guidance usable in the context of production because designers need to find, compare and apply identity choices consistently.
strategic_value: A navigable portal and automated tools can help Audi’s distributed teams implement a flexible system.
demonstration: The 26.4-second presentation shows tablet, phone and laptop views of the brand portal, moving through introduction, imagery, typography, animation curves and logo-ending examples.
practical_value: Compare guidance presentation on different screen sizes and distinguish explanatory specimens from interactive production tools.

content_islands.name: Device arrangement
content_islands.spec: Place tablet at upper left, phone in front and laptop at right against black.

content_islands.name: Guidance navigation
content_islands.spec: Keep the portal navigation visible while the devices scroll through guidance and examples.

content_islands.name: Motion demonstration
content_islands.spec: Show an animation curve and logo-ending example within the laptop view.

reference_purposes.Application: The clip demonstrates the guideline portal on three device formats.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Smart tools section says the portal makes the identity easier to understand and apply and describes automated logo-ending and ring-proportion tools.
